name: Diagnosed with TB
description: The number of patient diagnosed with TB for a selected period
creator: 82f18b44-6814-11e8-923f-e9a88dcb533f
sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total
FROM mamba_fact_patients_latest_tb_status a
JOIN mamba_fact_patients_latest_patient_demographics mdp
  ON mdp.patient_id = a.client_id
WHERE a.encounter_date >= ':startDate'
  AND a.encounter_date <  ':endDate'
  AND a.status IN ('TB Diagnosed - TB LAM','TB Diagnosed - Clinically diagnosed')
  AND mdp.birthdate IS NOT NULL
  AND mdp.gender IS NOT NULL
;
